points.description: States Conservationism (conservation) and Preservationism (preservation) as two of the philosophies, using these technical names.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one of the two is named correctly.

points.description: States Deep Ecology and Social Ecology as the other two philosophies, using these technical names.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one of the two is named correctly.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four named philosophies: Conservationism, Preservationism, Deep Ecology and Social Ecology, with correct technical names. Each point is worth 1 mark; if only one of its two items is given correctly, award half. A wrong extra philosophy (for example Sustainability or Environmentalism) means the point it falls under earns nothing; vague descriptions without the names earn nothing.
